roles.name: Trust Sentinel

roles.acceptance: Exact build artifact, both physical devices, two accounts, notification/deep-link and privacy proof; never count a CI build as user-ready.

roles.name: Community Signal
roles.mission: Measure genuine first-session participation, repeat use, useful discovery and retention, and draft high-quality opt-in launch growth tests.
roles.acceptance: Metrics with denominator, timestamp, real-vs-demo filters and evidence-linked observations; no fabricated users, outreach or publishing.
